title: evidence-words
description: Which receipt kinds (contracts/evidence.schema.json) can back which state word. The ONE table every resolver reads: compose lib/evidence.js (`kindBacks`, `checkCite`, used by withEvidence for the four state tools) and the ops claim_check.py (ledger, bus, the sm-ops H5 mirror), which loads this file by path (COMPOSE_CONTRACTS_DIR). A word with no row takes any kind. `kinds` ["*"] = any kind. `max_age_s`: the cited receipt's server `checked_at` is at most this old. `recheck`: the receipt is re-verified against the machine when cited (process: the pid is alive and its command contains the label).
_source: COMP-DOGFOOD-EVIDENCE-GATE-1 fix r1, review-postland.md F1 (a receipt was not bound to the claim it backs: a log receipt backed RUNNING, a file receipt backed LANDED)

RUNNING.why: a running job is a live fact: only a pid that is alive now, running the labelled command, checked within 15 min

LANDED.why: a landed change is a commit on the repo's default branch, or on a declared land branch (land_branches) when the receipt names it

DEPLOYED.why: what is deployed is a commit

COMPLETE.why: a completed feature is a commit or a command's output (its tests)
